definitions.explanation: A work arrangement where employees perform their duties from home rather than commuting to an office. Became widespread in Japan during the COVID-19 pandemic.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{在宅|ざいたく}ワークだ。
{在宅|ざいたく}ワーク⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えて→増える：01183_fueru⟧、⟦{通勤|つうきん}→通勤：03512_tsuukin⟧⟦しなく→する：00392_suru⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Remote work has increased, and I've stopped commuting.

examples.japanese: {在宅|ざいたく}ワーク⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自己|じこ}→自己：23357_jiko⟧⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It's said that self-management is important when working from home.

notes:
USAGE:
Became an everyday term in Japan from 2020 onward. Used both as a noun and with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. Often abbreviated in casual speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {在宅|ざいたく}ワーク⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to work from home)
- {在宅|ざいたく}ワーク⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}り{替|か}える→切り替える：04239_kirikaeru⟧ (to switch to remote work)
- {在宅|ざいたく}ワーク⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧ (work-from-home environment)
- {在宅|ざいたく}ワーク⟦{手当|てあて}→手当：04881_teate⟧ (remote work allowance)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦テレワーク→テレワーク：05397_terewaaku⟧: telework — a broader term covering any remote work, not only from home
- ⟦リモートワーク→リモートワーク：06095_rimootowaaku⟧: remote work — essentially synonymous, slightly more casual
